The serious accident that occurred three years ago in the Gotthard Base Tunnel is changing the safety regulations for European rail freight transport. The authorities and the rail industry have agreed on harmonised measures involving more frequent inspections of railcars and, in particular, their wheels, after investigations into the derailment in August 2023 revealed the risk of cracks and fractures.
